requiredNormalAuthorization: Open Cloudflare dashboard through the user's normal authenticated browser session.
Open Workers & Pages and create or connect a Pages project using the GitHub OAuth integration.
Authorize repository hemangsah/qelly-intelligence without supplying any raw token to Qelly or ChatGPT.
Use npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm run build:frontend and output directory dist/frontend.
Keep the project on Pages Free with no payment method or paid overages.
Expose the resulting official Pages project/deployment actions to the connected Cloudflare capability so exact-SHA deployment and verification can continue.
